column1: # --clsselectp scan, round 2, centered on the current compiled default (15).
# The first scan (configs-clsselectp.tsv: cs0/10/20/30) predates several
# defaults changes since (slope, floor, inject, dynmul, oldestsource) and
# anchored at 0 rather than the current default, so it's stale for a clean
# comparison under today's compiled defaults. This round brackets the
# clsselectp is the random-source-shortcut probability in percent: with
# probability clsselectp/100 the neighbor scan is skipped and the sink draws
# random satisfied source(s) instead (also the only channel that moves
# weight between the positive- and negative-literal constraint classes).
